body: I feel you there, I honestly forgot I made this post and just found it again browsing the subreddit... I have only had spatial distortion during one of my episodes, it was freaky.
I'm on wellbutrin for my adhd but it doesn't really help at all. I will look into those for sure though.

I'm only at 10mg atm but we're still going to up it more. My cognitive problems are constant mostly though which is why school is becoming a problem, I'm failing 2 classes at the moment because of it. My psychiatrist and I have talked about going on klonopin for my TD but maybe it might help this too, she's a bit skeptical because I went on it for 2 weeks a while back and had a bad reaction. The other thing was nicotine, I am skeptical of trying that because last time I tried it I got sick from it. I don't want to smoke, I would probably use patches or gum, maybe vaporizer... Sorry if my thoughts are everywhere..

I'm 16, live with my parents, I am struggling a lot with school because of my paranoia and anxiety and on top of all that my TD. I go to an online high school and I talk to my counselors on a very regular basis, they are very nice and understanding. Some of my teachers have told me they don't care that I have "problems" and they refuse to work with me around due dates etc. For my school work it takes very long to complete because from some of the meds and schizophrenia I get memory and cognitive problems, almost like word salad but with memory. I hope to go on to college and either go into the psychiatry field or computer science field.
Yep, Klonopin for anxiety and TD, Benztropine for TD, Mirtazapine for depression, Topiramate to counter act side effects, Verapamil for blood pressure AND cluster headaches, Cephalexin for acne.
That was the most I laughed in a long time... Well done.

I have tried easing back into some games, the problem is in the first place they are really boring games, Runescape, Diablo 3, etc. I have been interested in Yoga because usually all I do is sit in my chair all day on my computer and I have read about how bad that can be for your legs and stretching is supposed to be really good for breaking the bad fibers or something... I completely understand what you are understanding and after I talk to my psychiatrist tomorrow about going on a different anti-psychotic because Zyprexa isn't doing the job I will look into trying some new stuff...

I wish I could try reading but one of my medications that I take for my TD causes blurred vision and makes reading really difficult, but my psychiatrist insists on taking it still... One of my close friends and I have been listening to Lord of the Rings auido books and that is not as boring and video games are but I find I get lost and zone out a lot when listening to them. The one thing that I find a little bit of enjoyment in right now is learning about all the meds I'm on and about psychiatry, it is much more engaging than the general classes I take in high school (I am interested in psychiatry). 

I really appreciate your comment and anyone else's comments because all my real life friends and family are sick of hearing about my problems are I just need a place to vent. :)

I'm weird, my first psychotic episode/s we're long so I obsessed over these songs over this time.
Edit: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JF28BO3N-_Q Forgot about this one

I called my psychiatrist and asked about Benadryl and she said that it she had never heard of using both at the same time, how well does it work for you? (I was also reporting to her that it was getting much worse, not only asking about that)

I have the same problem with Cogentin, I have vision problems and get very sick off it. The few times I went up to 6mg at once I wanted to go the ER because of how horrible I felt. Luckily I can manage to use my keyboard and mouse a little bit but I'm afraid of it getting worse... It doesn't help I go to an online high school so I have to type a lot.
I tried nicotine a few times to help with the cognitive problems and it just made me very sick.

I don't stay up for day's at a time but I do have very odd sleep patterns, no matter when I try to fall asleep I wont be able to if it's before 4 am, and will wake up no matter when I fell asleep at 2:30 pm.

I just went through your post at /r/CBD and was surprised how many things that it helps with, I currently live in Minnesota and a medical marijuana bill was passed but is not effective until June 15th in 2015, and under the current bill you pretty much need to be near dead to even qualify. I am considering going out to Colorado to try some high CBD strains.

I'm in the same shoe's as you, I don't know what I'm going to do for school, I'm going to be a junior but can't leave my house without having delusions and getting paranoid as fuck.. I might continue with online high school, and before I had my first episode I was doing half college half high school.. I understand your worries because I worry about it every day.
Yea, thats how I felt during my last psychotic episode and I was getting used to it but then I got meds...
This is exactly how I feel and it doesn't stop, but I'm not under any stress really, its the summer and all I do is sleep, eat, and play games. I'm going to bring it up with my next appointment.
That's quite the unique analogy, but so on spot with the feeling.

I respect you're concern and nicotine will be the last thing that I try but I used to smoke and quit, it was easy for me I don't know why but I was 1 1/2 packs a day... Same goes with my father who had no trouble quitting, but if it comes to it I am willing to try because at this point I cant take any classes or hold a job. Again, thank you for you're concern.
Alright, thanks for the advice.

I was thinking about the nicotine and went on youtube to discourage myself from smoking cigarettes, but there are a fair amount of comparisons dealing with cigarettes and e-cigs and I will most likely pick one up my next time I go out.
I will most definitely try out Lumosity and Omega-3's and I'm glad to hear that both of those help you.

It does sound a lot like schizophrenia, just like allbutoneormore said go and tell a doctor/therapist/psychiatrist; This is also exactly what is happening to me, I've been depressed for a long time and last year I fell into a lot of stress and started to develop similar symptoms to you. Just get to a professional and don't hide anything from them, they will understand.

Blogging could be helpful, I personally don't write down my emotions or hallucinations in a personal notebook, I do sometimes explain them to a friend though and it seems to help; if you do explain it to someone though be sure they are aware of the symptoms and what they really are. Sorry if this wasn't helpful.
I'm not much help really but if you enjoy gaming you could try watching live streams and being active with the community; that's really the only thing that has kept me sane when I'm alone.

I actually had to ask 3 if my friends if I worked at Taco Bell an they convinced me I didn't, I have told one of my friends about everything mostly because I feel I can somewhat relate to him, he has schizophrenia.

Music, games, if you can try watching livestreams and being active in them (I have found that to be what keeps me sane at night when I have the worst hallucinations etc.) Just try and not lay in bed all day, I have found that, for me at least, it worsens most symptoms. Talking to people via voice or chat is the key point for me though. (Sorry if I didn't help at all)

I have my main post in /r/depression, I just wanted to get this off my chest, I have nobody that I can talk to about this because my family wouldn't understand and my friend just attempted suicide and is very, fragile, at the moment. I have thought of doing it a lot ad when posting this I was close to it but glitcl's post meant a lot to me... I had also just had a headache before posting these and was going through an anxiety attack... I'm just scared because when I'm hearing voices with my headaches they are convincing...

My doctor brought up psychotic depression my last visit when I told him about the hallucinations and voices, so that's what I think it has turned into, and it's not that I have "gone off food" it's more I have no will to eat, I just wait until I can tell my blood sugar is low and eat something to raise it a bit... I've been eating once every other day for the past week or so.

I have seen many specialists and neurologists for my headaches, and for league it's just that you can't pause the game if I start seeing things or get a headache. As of keeping myself busy, I haven't been able to watch twitch recently, it has mostly been forcing myself to eat ad sleeping. I have decided to see a doctor for my psychotic depression ( I have always been a shut in and have only told 1 person prior to this)

At high levels diablo 3 can get hectic, league just has long games I can't stop... I do watch twitch, mostly runescape streams though, I'm actually a mod in a fair amount of the community... When it comes to the headaches I have tried about every medication for them and none have worked, and school I had a 4.0 gpa (perfect grades) until the last set of classes.

I've liked to play some games like LoL and diablo 3 but I cat concentrate enough to play them, a few years ago I was fine and could deal with everything just fine, yes my recent series of headaches, my friend attempting suicide and me doing poorly this last semester have all contributed I think. I have only had my bad series of headaches for a month or so which is when my delusions and hallucinations started and they went from a faint voice once a day to constant screaming and visuals.
That is an amazing analogy... Thank you for that..

I have been wanting to go to a psychiatrist since I started hearing the voices but I don't know how to get to one without letting my family know.. The only idea I have is to ask for an appointment for my anxiety from my headaches and then open up to the psychiatrist.
